result.summary: The page looks mostly correct, but there are minor styling inconsistencies in the restaurant card badges and favorite icons.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the delivery-time pills are inconsistent: the first card uses a white pill with dark text at the top-left, while the second card uses a dark pill with white text at the bottom-left.
issues.suggestion: Use a single pill style and a fixed position for delivery-time labels across all cards in the carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the favorite-heart icons are treated differently: the ramen card shows a plain outline, while the pizza card shows the same outline on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a uniform heart-icon treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
